headline: Finance Subcommittee to review a $393,000 net school spending shortfall and FY26 and FY27 financial reports.
summary: The subcommittee will discuss the net school spending shortfall, enrollment-related budget limits, and financial reports for FY26 and FY27. It will also review warrants, the Melvin Klayman Trust Scholarship, rental fees, and insurance coverage.
items: Rental Fees and Insurance Coverage Review
location: Malden City Hall - Room 113, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden
